title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: NYSORA's serratus patient view, male chest: the patient's left side from the front, head at the top, left arm abducted to the image right with the armpit visible.
teachingPoint: Probe head on the mid-axillary line just below nipple level (4th-5th ribs), the probe lying front-to-back; needle in-plane, level, from the anterior side.
claims: Copies NYSORA Fig-9's composition: patient's left side, head up, arm abducted to the right (owner, 2026-10-03; concept only, not committed; NYSORA's side used instead of the house right at the owner's direction).

Probe head on the mid-axillary line just below nipple level, the probe tilted down to the lower right along the same line as the needle - in-plane, as in NYSORA Fig-9 (record: transverse over the mid-axillary line).
Needle coming in along the probe's line from the anterior side, its tip entering the skin at the probe's head end (record: in-plane from the superior-anterior end).
Dashed: the mid-axillary line. Labels: Linear probe, Block needle, Axilla, Mid-axillary line.
